research_question: Does already-observed FX price confirmation of the current relative 2Y repricing direction improve subsequent FX outcomes?

causal_timing.already_observed_fx_move: previous observation target_return for the same currency
causal_timing.forbidden: current or future target_return may not be used to define confirmation state

groups.PRICE_CONFIRMS_RATES: sign(previous target_return) == sign(current d_diff_2y), both nonzero

evaluation.primary_return_1m: current d_diff_2y sign multiplied by current target_return
evaluation.primary_return_3m: current d_diff_2y sign multiplied by sum of current and next two target_returns for same currency
